cards.title: Strategic Opportunity & Market Impact
cards.botDialogue: Welcome! I am Aayam. Let's look at the strategic business opportunity for HanaMorph - Automated SAP HANA to SAP Datasphere Modernization Studio. Here is how we transform operational velocity.
bullets: Monolithic CTE Lineage Collapse: Classical migration scripts collapse multi-tier calculation views into opaque, monolithic SQL WITH (CTE) statements, destroying intermediate node auditability and lineage in SAP Datasphere.

Dependency & Import Failure Loops: Attribute naming mismatches (e.g. PARTNER vs PARTNR) and uncompiled calculated attributes trigger missing-object deployment crashes in Datasphere CSN import services.
View Sprawl & Technical Debt: Legacy HANA environments carry 1,800+ calculation views with 80%+ duplicate pipelines on core tables (ACDOCA, BNKA), causing ballooning cloud compute costs.
